title: Grammar + Reality Domain Derivation
purpose: Derive evidence-bounded grammar and reality-domain candidates from W8D evidence-lineaged RRE readouts without auto-assigning runtime positions.
rules: Only W8D records with REQUIRED_LANES_COMPLETE may enter derivation work.
A complete required-lane set is necessary but not sufficient for grammar/domain derivation.
grammarId must cite the canonical stable definition and evidence refs that directly support that definition.
realityDomainId must satisfy its operational evidence test using cited evidence; currentness alone never implies P2.
Every evidenceRef must belong to the W8D readout evidenceRefs for the same dossier.
The submitted readoutReference must exactly match the W8D readout reference for the dossier.
A dossier may have multiple subsystem candidates; no single global candidate is forced.
Grammar/domain candidate generation does not equal runtime-position candidate generation.
Historical RP-44 or any source-window reference cannot determine a current grammar/domain candidate.
INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and CONFLICTED remain governed outputs.
